t: Best menu I've ever used. The heist editor alone is worth it, and the amount of features for the price is insane. Support team is super helpful too.
The heist editor is a game changer. Set up Cayo solo and made millions in a day. Easy to follow even if you have never touched a menu before.
Switched from another menu and never looked back. Updates are frequent, stability is amazing, and the UI is so clean. Lifetime is a steal.
Been on Enhanced for months and never had an issue. Legacy and Enhanced both work flawlessly. Best money I have spent on anything gaming related.
Premium Plus with BattlEye on is the real deal. I run public lobbies with friends who do not mod at all and nobody gets kicked.
Hands down the smoothest menu out there. No crashes, no lag, just works every time. The vehicle spawner and modded outfits are my favourite.
The stat editor and unlock all saved me hundreds of hours of grinding. Recovery worked exactly like the guide said it would.
Can't believe this is free. The free version has more in it than most paid menus. Teleports and the vehicle spawner work perfectly.
The Lua scripting support is insane. I've made custom scripts for my crew and everyone loves it. The dev team actually listens to feedback.
Menu was updated and working the same week the Kortz Center heist dropped. That turnaround is why I keep recommending it.
Started on the free version and was impressed by how much is included. The Discord community is super active and helpful. Upgrading soon.
Easily the most complete RedM menu around. ESP and aimbot are dialled in, and it holds up on the big RP servers.
The Lua executor is what sold me. I load my own scripts on RedM and it has not failed once. Nothing else on the market comes close.
Trolling options are unmatched and the server tools actually work. Support answered me in Discord within minutes when I had a question.
Runs clean on every server I have tried it on. Updates land fast after RedM patches, which is more than I can say for what I used before.
Been using it daily for RP and it has never once given me trouble. Setup took about five minutes following the guide on the site.
Tried the free version expecting very little and got way more than I bargained for. Ended up buying premium the same night.
Aimbot and ESP are the cleanest I have used on FiveM. The Lua executor is a massive bonus, I run my own scripts on it constantly.
Works on every server I have thrown at it. Menu never stutters even on the heavy RP servers with hundreds of players.
PVP features are genuinely good, not the half broken stuff you get elsewhere. Setup guide on the site had me running in minutes.
Free version is more than enough to see what it can do. Installed the VC runtimes like the guide says and had zero problems.
Swapping to DX12 like the guide said fixed my crashing instantly. Since then it has been completely stable in story and online.
Godmode, money and gold all work exactly as advertised. RDR2 menus are usually an afterthought, this one clearly is not.
No BattlEye to deal with on RDR2 so it was the easiest setup of any menu I own. Loaded first try and has not missed since.
The skin changer is the best part. Knives, gloves and agents all swap instantly and everything looks exactly right in game.
Dual UI is a nice touch, I use ListUI and my friend prefers ClickUI. ESP and triggerbot are sharp and it has stayed undetected for me.
Free and better than cheats people are charging for. Bhop and no recoil feel natural rather than obviously robotic.
